About booking

Is the time I pick guaranteed?

It's a request. We confirm it — or offer the nearest free time — within one business day. Nothing is locked in until you've accepted the quote and paid the deposit.

How soon can you come?

The earliest you can request is two days from today. If it's urgent, say so in the notes and we'll try to fit you in sooner.

Can I change the day later?

Yes — just reply to the email we send you. Rain reschedules are always free.

How do I pay?

Bank transfer. A deposit of $20 or 20% of the quoted price, whichever is higher, confirms your booking within 24 hours of accepting the quote. The rest is due on the day.
